_about: Clinic v2 prototype (docs/game-design/modes/clinic.md part A): the approved backgrounds (sources/art/clinic-v2/, cut to webp in assets/clinic/rooms/) shown at full strength, and where the stand-in pieces stand on them. Every x/y is a share of the picture (1536 x 1024, aspect 1.5): x across, y down; a person's y is where their feet (or stool) meet the floor; h is their height as a share of the picture's height. `need` = the x-range that must stay on screen (the scene box covers the play area when it can; when the play area is too narrow for `need`, the box fits `need`'s width and sits on the bottom, and a soft mirrored strip of the wall fills above it). Placement checked against build/reports/clinic-bg-check/ (VISUAL-QA 2b).

square._about: A2 (5 Oct), R3: the square room (CB2b kept pixel for pixel in rows 256-1280, R3's ceiling and floor bands); a screen taller than the room shows its whole width (js/clinic/stages/common.js squareFit)

waiting._about: The six-seat bench (cushion centres), the standing spots by the doctor's door and the desk, (two little stools in front, then a spot by the window, were tried for 9-10 people: they hid the bench's ticks and faces, so level 5 fills the room with the babies and children sitting with the grown-ups instead). adult = an adult's height sitting (a child is `child` of it); the heart poster's frame ends at y 0.31, so a sitting adult's head (0.745 - 0.36 = 0.385) stays under it (the bg-check note).

exam._about: CB2b: the patient sits on the bed's edge (the mattress top at y 0.53, the step stool's top at 0.66, the floor at 0.8), facing us; the stand-in doctor stands to the right, turned 3/4. fig = the figure's box (the patient DOM figure draws seated inside it, feet at its bottom).

side._about: A1 (5 Oct), the art plan section 3.1 W7: side-on, the patient sits on the bed's right-hand end in profile, facing right (the knee, ear and eye test B zooms); x = the seat anchor across, seat = the mattress top it sits on.

stand._about: CB3b: the patient stands on the floor in front of the plain wall between the anatomy poster and the height chart; the doctor to the right.

phone._about: S03 (CLN-94): on a short screen (under 480 px) she and the doctor stand bigger, their feet lower (she stays a child beside him)

pharmacy._about: CB4c: the painted belt's surface runs edge to edge between y 0.615 and 0.69; items stand on it (their base at `beltY`, `itemH` tall); the counter strip in front (y 0.73 to 1) holds the pantry-style tray.

door._about: CB5, clinic fixes 13d: the doctor and the patient stand on the LEFT, in the free wall space (not by the door, where the face circle sat on the green cross sign), turned to each other while they talk. The feeling cards open in a thought bubble from the patient's head, out to the right (levels 1-2); from level 3 the help items sit in a tray along the bottom of the screen.
